card.name: Table and layout separators
card.fires_on: Layout marks in scraped web text: table pipes, bullet marks and spaces between numbers. They often sit where a title, list item or new section starts.

modes.label: Pipes and bullets
modes.description: A pipe or bullet mark in a flattened table, list or page header, often after a title or at a section break.

modes.label: Spaces between numbers
modes.description: A space separating numeric columns in command output or data tables.

card.plain: It marks the dividers in messy web tables and lists, such as pipes, bullets and spaces between numbers.
